laura (People Ops): quick note for calibration orgs: new role tagging for this cycle + conflict-of-interest flow. please read.

owen (People Ops): TL;DR: reviewers now select one of three reviewer roles when submitting feedback: primary, independent reviewer, or subject-matter consultant.

maya (Cal Lead): what does subject-matter consultant mean in practice?

laura (People Ops): consults provide technical context only, don't propose ratings. they can be used when domain expertise is needed (e.g., ML research internals).

drew (Manager - Infra): how do we prevent a manager from picking their own consultant? potential COI.

owen (People Ops): We added a conflict-of-interest checkbox in the reviewer form. if a COI is flagged, the review is routed to independent review queue and ppl-ops will validate.

cheng (IC - Research): If my external collaborator (non-Redwood) provides input, can they be a consultant?

laura (People Ops): yes but external consultants must sign the NDA addendum (link: https://redwood.app/legal/nondisclosure-addendum). People Ops will send the form; please don't attach external feedback to packets until cleared.

maya (Cal Lead): Will consultants' notes be visible to ICs?

owen (People Ops): Visible to the manager and calibration members only; consultant notes are redacted from the public packet shared with the IC.

drew (Manager - Infra): Any changes to calibration chair assignments? last cycle we had a chair double-booked.

laura (People Ops): Chairs are auto-assigned based on past load and role. This cycle we added a "backup chair" field so if the chair declines, the backup is invited immediately (reduces churn). chairs will get an invite + an accept/decline link. If both decline, we escalate to the cohort lead.

cheng (IC - Research): Is there a way to see chair load across teams?

maya (Cal Lead): i'll share a simple spreadsheet of invited chairs and accept statuses later today.

ops-bot: Calendar update: Calibration cohort C  Apr 07 16:00 UTC. Reminder will post Apr 06 16:00 UTC.

laura (People Ops): Another small change: reviewers who miss confirmation for >48h will be flagged; ppl-ops will DM and if still unconfirmed by 72h, we reassign to an alternate reviewer.

drew (Manager - Infra): ok. can we keep a short audit trail for these reassignments? last time it was tricky for appeals.

owen (People Ops): yes, audit includes who was invited, timestamps, who reassigned, and reason. stored for 2 years.

maya (Cal Lead): question on confidentiality: can managers forward packets to other managers for advice?

laura (People Ops): only via the "peer consult" workflow in the platform (it logs the share and requires recipient to accept confidentiality terms). don't forward PDFs.

cheng (IC - Research): final Q: any compensation or spot bonus for external consultants?

owen (People Ops): we can issue token honoraria for vetted external consultants on a per-case basis. request via this form: https://redwood.app/forms/consult-honorarium?id=CONS-2026-01. finance approval required for amounts >$500.

drew (Manager - Infra): sweet. that'll help with expert reviews.

maya (Cal Lead): thanks all. i'll fold these updates into the calibration kickoff slide and share with cohort leads.

laura (People Ops): thanks everyone  please flag anything else you want added before we lock the workflow tonight.
